item.title: Man accused of killing pregnant Downers Grove mom is hospitalized in critical condition: officials
item.description: Nedas Revuckas, the man accused of killing a pregnant mother in Downers Grove, is in critical condition after suffering self-inflicted injuries, and was denied pretrial release on Thursday.

item.title: Man beaten to death in suburban group home; roommate charged
item.description: CHICAGO HEIGHTS, Ill. — A man was beaten to death at a group home in Chicago Heights and his roommate was charged with murder. item.title: Friday was ninth consecutive day below normal, with no end in sight
item.description: Friday was another chilly day across the Chicago area with highs well below normal, peaking in the upper teens officially at O’Hare but reaching the low 20s at Midway and the Lakefront.

item.title: Harvey Mayor Christopher Clark has died, according to city officials
item.description: The City of Harvey has confirmed the passing of Mayor Christopher J. Clark and will hold a special city council meeting to appoint a Mayor Pro Temp.

item.title: Brazen Chinatown shooting of grandfather results in 65-year prison term for killer
item.description: A motive in the shooting remains unknown.

item.title: Palatine police searching for missing 14-year-old girl who may have been picked up by unknown vehicle
item.description: The Palatine Police Department is asking for the public's help in finding a missing 14-year-old girl who may have been picked up by an unknown vehicle.

item.title: 'Home Alone' and 'Schitt's Creek' actress Catherine O'Hara dies at 71
item.description: Catherine O'Hara, the Emmy-winning actor known for her comedic roles in "Home Alone" and "Schitt's Creek", died at 71 in Los Angeles after a brief illness.

item.title: Winter Storm Warning dropped in Cook County, still in effect for Northwest Indiana
item.description: A Winter Storm Warning is in effect for a portion of Cook County and Lake and Porter counties in Indiana until 6 p.m. Friday, with snow totals ranging from 1 to 9 inches depending on the area.

item.title: Chicagoans rally against immigration enforcement in national shutdown
item.description: A national shutdown called for supporters to stay home from work and not go shopping Friday to protest federal immigration enforcement.
